issues.title: Empty hash maps and a synthetic/main-context review can pass formal acceptance
issues.problem: audit() checks only the entries supplied by reports and review. Empty sourceHashes/reportHashes therefore skip every binding check. The review gate checks implementationAuthored=false and nonempty identity strings but does not require INDEPENDENT_CODEX_AGENT or a context different from the implementation context. The default seal validator repeats these weaknesses by allowing absent maps and any nonempty runner kind.
issues.impact: A changed verification runner can be accepted after the source maps are cleared; an explicitly synthetic review using the main task context is reported as independentReviewVerified=true. Raw SHA-256 equality for retained entries does not prevent removal of the binding itself.
issues.evidence: The read-only VM probe below actually executed the unchanged audit code. The unmodified control and both adversarial in-memory overlays exited 0/PASS. No synthetic PASS review was written to disk.
issues.recommendation: Require the declared source set and all frozen output report paths, reject missing/empty/deleted bindings, compare every hash, and require INDEPENDENT_CODEX_AGENT with distinct recorded implementation/reviewer contexts in formal acceptance. Keep synthetic protocol identities behind an explicit isolated fixture mode that cannot report the normal phase-seal scope. Add rejection cases for omitted entries, synthetic identity and same context.

issues.title: ApiKeyConfig conflicts with its frozen Phase010 storage and producer contract
issues.problem: encryptedKey is specified as Prisma Json, while the frozen producer explicitly requires String @db.Text containing canonical JSON. The revision row says it is added in Phase012, but Phase010 already requires revision Int default(0) with a nonnegative CHECK.
issues.impact: The unique project database design directs the first migration to a different storage type and delays a field required by the frozen producer; later migration and encryption code cannot simultaneously follow both definitions.
issues.evidence: Independent `node docs/phase-plans/verify-phase001.mjs --check database` exited 0 despite the mismatch. Main agent explicitly acknowledged both conflicts before this report.
issues.recommendation: Use String/Text with canonical JSON serialization and schema validation; produce nonnullable revision with ApiKeyConfig in Phase010. Synchronize the later JSON-field paragraph and add exact type/nullability/producer assertions with negative cases.

issues.title: DurableTask claim index names an unregistered timestamp column
issues.problem: The index rules prescribe task claim (status,nextAttemptAt,leaseUntil,id). DurableTask's exact canonical fields use availableAt; nextAttemptAt belongs to DataRequest ERASE continuation and is not a DurableTask field.
issues.impact: Implementing the specified claim index in Phase016 either references a nonexistent column or introduces a conflicting task scheduling field.
issues.evidence: Compared the index paragraph against canonical section 3.7 and Phase016's mandatory reuse of that exact schema.
issues.recommendation: Specify the DurableTask index with availableAt and retain nextAttemptAt only for the DataRequest continuation contract. Add a focused assertion against the frozen task field name.
